WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 0 (electric_service_billing_and_trouble, category service). Round 2 (rework after the policy-task audit) - every figure below is the round-2 recomputation.
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"task": 0, "key": "env_0043_rural_electric_cooperative/electric_service_billing_and_trouble/0", "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [6, 6, 5, 6]}. Allocation: late charge assessment 6 factors, meter error refund 6, reconnection payment 5, reconnect fee 6. Task 1 draw: prerequisite_problems 2, factor_counts [4, 6, 5].
[Why a good test] A Schedule FH farm member disconnected for nonpayment asks only to get the power back on today and what to pay. The scored numbers are the reconnection payment she keys in herself (983.25) and the reconnect fee (45.00 in round 1, 115.00 now). Between the request and those numbers the policies place two unmet obligations the records already owe - the late payment charge on the unpaid September bill and the meter error refund on a meter test found fast - which the agent must read out of the reconnection-payment rule's two prerequisite sentences, find false in the ledger, resolve, and only then compute. Every number is a multi-factor calculation over a year of bills, payments, pledges, tests and three other products (arrangement, deposit, area light).
[Scope snapshot] Claimed here: service_ext_late_charge_assessment, service_ext_meter_error_refund, service_ext_reconnection_payment, service_ext_reconnect_fee; tools assess_late_charge_b4948c69, post_meter_error_credit_d380ee62, pay_reconnection_amount_66e1876e (owner=user), reconnect_service_ea86e786. Task 1 holds the seasonal minimum, restore payment and restore fee; the scopes are disjoint and together cover all seven policies.
[Problem-tree card] Root service_ext_reconnect_fee. Edge R->P: state_gate (service_evt_reconnect.past_due_covered is the base gate this payment completes), form state, sentence 'The reconnection, and the reconnect fee billed with it, is made only after a payment at least equal to the reconnection payment the account requires stands on the account, posted on the day of reconnection.' resolved_by pay_reconnection_amount_66e1876e (owner user). Edge P->L: value_input, gate month_charges, form state, 'The reconnection payment is fixed only after every bill left unpaid past its due date carries its late payment charge line on the account.' resolved_by assess_late_charge_b4948c69. Edge P->C: value_input, gate month_credits, form state, 'The reconnection payment is not worked out until every meter test on the account that found the meter fast carries its meter error refund credit.' resolved_by post_meter_error_credit_d380ee62. Two value_input edges >= max(3-1,1). Topological order L, C, P, R; L and C commute.
[Four-point test and single write] Each sentence carries 'only after' or 'not ... until', waits on a record-visible state, names no tool, id or code token, and has the edge's strength and scope. Late payment charge lines are booked only by the late charge tool; meter_error_refund credits only by the meter refund tool. Correction (audit G8): two user tools post a phone card payment row - pay_reconnection_amount_66e1876e and the task-1 tool pay_restore_balance_91f3e2ab - so the payment state is not single-write at the row level; the hop is fixed by the business term and the docstrings: the sentence waits on 'the reconnection payment', which only service_ext_reconnection_payment defines, and round 2 restricts the two docstrings to mutually exclusive account states ('your electric service account that stands disconnected for nonpayment ... not the line for an idle seasonal or irrigation account or for an account in service' versus 'your idle seasonal or irrigation service account ... not the line for an account disconnected for nonpayment'). This account is disconnected_nonpay, so exactly one tool fits.
[Unmet at the opening] P->L: the September bill (facility line dated 2026-09-15, due 2026-10-05) has no late charge; the latest late charge is billing_period 2026-08. P->C: the 2026-09-24 test is fast and no credit names it; the only meter_error_refund credit names the 2019 test. R->P: the only payment dated 2026-10-06 is the 100.00 mail check.
[Deletion sensitivity, actual run] skip L -> reconnection payment 979.48 (gold 983.25); skip C -> 1023.20; skip both -> 1019.43; skip P -> terminal balance 878.25 instead of -105.00. Swapped L/C order -> L 3.77, C 39.95, P 983.25, R 115.00 identical. No user hint: the persona names no late charge, bill, meter test, refund or credit; only the passive 'If the representative tells you something else has to be put on the account or looked after ... go ahead'. Tools do not block: every body reads only the account row and writes.
[Factor card - late charge, gold 3.77, whole baseline 8.67] late_charge_rate_tier (parameter, multi-source): four late charges in twelve months AND no return -> 1.75; baseline 1.50 -> 3.23; near-miss: the 2025-09-12 return is exactly twelve whole months back. pledge_deduction (parameter, multi-source): liheap pledge 150.00 of 2026-10-02 within 30 days, before the 2026-10-05 due date, no liheap payment this month -> 150.00; baseline 0 -> 5.74. assisted_household_multiplier (parameter since round 2, audit G1: its tiers select a number): liheap -> 0.75; baseline 1 -> 5.03. payments_applied_to_bill (method): the county_emergency_assistance 75.00 of 2026-09-30 has no county pledge -> applied directly; member payments 220.00 stay below the earlier unpaid 516.65; baseline oldest-first -> 4.76. area_light_line_exclusion (parameter): rental line 12.40 -> excluded; baseline -> 3.93. arrangement_line_exclusion (parameter, cross-difficulty arrange): arrangement defaulted 2026-09-09 -> rebill 53.01 excluded; baseline -> 4.47. Late-charged amount 577.78 - 12.40 - 53.01 - 75.00 - 150.00 = 287.37; 287.37 x 1.75% x 0.75 = 3.77.
[Factor card - meter error refund, gold 39.95, whole baseline 45.25] rebill_window_length (method, window convention): accurate test 2026-06-25, 3 months -> July-September lines; baseline 6 months -> 69.11. over_registered_energy_pricing (method, new in round 2 replacing the PCA-lines ladder of audit G3): FH is a declining-block schedule and the window's 8105 kWh exceed 1500 x 3 lines, so the over-registered 8105 x 0.013807 = 111.90 kWh are refunded at the block-2 rate 0.10420 = 11.66; baseline share of the energy charges (908.44 x 0.013807 = 12.54) -> 40.84. overbilled_share_method (method): 3.40 < 6.00 with accurate tests in twelve months -> 1.40/101.40; baseline 3.40/103.40 -> 56.21. late_charge_refund_on_overbilling (parameter): 8.11 (3.00 + 5.11; a late charge dated after the test is left out, so the 3.77 booked first in the other order never enters), disconnect date present -> full; baseline -> 31.77. overbilling_interest (parameter since round 2, G1): three billed energy lines -> factor 1.0092; baseline -> 39.77. meter_test_fee_refund (parameter): no fee in the window, the 40.00 fee of 2026-06-25 inside meter_error_rebill_max_months (six) whole months (round 2 narrows the old twelve-month reach, audit G11) -> 20.00; baseline -> 19.95. (11.66 + 8.11) x 1.0092 = 19.95, + 20.00 = 39.95.
[Factor card - reconnection payment, gold 983.25, whole baseline 221.65] amount_owed_for_reconnection (method, multi-source): one reconnect fee in twelve months (2025-11-24) AND no return -> notice 516.65 + month charges 581.55 - month credits 39.95 = 1058.25; baseline notice -> 441.65. payments_counted (method): echeck 120.00 (3 days) and mail check 100.00 (0 days) uncleared -> 75.00 counted; baseline 295.00 -> 763.25. pledge_selection (method): two liheap pledges, no liheap payment -> latest 150.00; baseline 240.00 -> 893.25 (round 2 removed the compute-only conjunct of audit G5). pledge_credit (parameter): liheap within 30 days -> full; baseline -> 1133.25. deposit_installment_with_reconnection (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty deposit; rewritten in round 2 after audit G4/T0-1): the tier now follows the deposit charter - first installment first_installment_pct (50) percent, the rest split over the remaining installments due with the next bills, and with installment_default_accelerates an installment unpaid on its due date makes the whole unpaid remainder due at once and past due on the service account. The seeded Residential Credit Reestablishment Deposit now holds 150.00 (its 50 percent first installment of 300.00, posted at the 2025-11-24 reconnection) and is partially_paid; ten whole months later its later installments are past due -> whole remainder 150.00; baseline 0 -> 833.25.
[Factor card - reconnect fee, gold 115.00, whole baseline 75.00] crew_charge (parameter): remote meter, no damage report -> 25.00; baseline 75.00 -> 165.00. reconnection_lookback_window (method, anchor of the look-back, multi-source, cross-difficulty arrange; round 3 rewrite after audit R2-G1/R2-1, which found the round-2 version only swapped the constant 24/18/12 months): the tier now changes the starting event the reconnections are counted from - the connect date after a defaulted arrangement, the latest returned payment's posting date after a return, otherwise a rolling standard_lookback_months window. Arrangement defaulted 2026-09-09 -> every reconnect fee since connection 2008-04-21 is counted; baseline rolling 12 months -> 90.00. repeat_reconnection_surcharge (parameter): two reconnect fees since connection (2024-12-12, 2025-11-24) -> 50.00; baseline -> 65.00; near-miss: the 2024-12-12 fee lies outside the rolling twelve months. deposit_basis_surcharge (parameter, cross-difficulty deposit; round 2 reads the deposit's assessment basis instead of its paid status, so the deposit money collected in the reconnection payment cannot contradict it - audit G15): reconnect_after_nonpay -> 10.00; baseline -> 105.00. site_inspection_charge (parameter): 5 days disconnected -> 15.00; baseline -> 100.00. area_light_restoration_charge (parameter, cross light): the LED 70W light has been out_of_service since its confirmed light-out of 2026-09-29 (round 2 moved the date off the disconnect day, audit observation) -> 15.00; baseline -> 100.00. 25 + 50 + 10 + 15 + 15 = 115.00. The assisted-household reconnect multiplier of round 1 is removed together with its override of 'The reconnect fee is never waived at the service desk.', which is inherited again.
[Overrides and inheritance] Late charge: overwrite of service_evt_late_charge's past-due sentence, its rate sentence and - new in round 2 (audit G7) - 'No late charge is assessed on a bill whose past-due amount is fully covered by an energy assistance pledge recorded on or before the due date, nor on the portion of a balance moved into an active payment arrangement.', replaced by the pledge-deduction sentence (the arrangement half is carried by the arrangement-lines ladder); and of service_evt_program_charges' 'Program charges count toward the past-due amount and the late charge like any other charge.'. The due-date gate, once-per-bill and minimum stay. Meter refund: overwrite of service_evt_meter_test's refund sentence. Reconnect fee: overwrite of the fee-selection sentence only. Reconnection payment: no base provision for a payment amount, overwrite []; base past_due_covered stays a necessary condition.
[Base-invariant card] due_date_passed (time): bill date 2026-09-15 + 20 days counted from the day after = 2026-10-05, boundary exclusive; 2026-10-05 fails, 2026-10-06 passes. one_credit_per_source: no credit names the 2026-09-24 test. cash_only_channel: cash_only_until empty. past_due_covered: payments since 2026-09-09 (75 + 120 + 100 + 983.25) exceed 516.65 at the reconnection; arrangement (defaulted) and prepay (converted 2022) rows show no other coverage. deposit_on_file: partially_paid deposit on the same account. service_agg_member_balance: policy_scope.
[Business-object card] Account 08-4117-204 (meter 41702216); late charge object the 2026-09 bill; refund object the 2026-09-24 test; reconnection payment object the notice of 2026-09-09 plus the month's lines; arrangement rebill and area-light rental lines identified by charge_component and source.
[Seed rows] customers: Marcy Albright (0412763, 2705551384, 1729). service_accounts: the single FH account, disconnected_nonpay since Thursday 2026-10-01, notice 2026-09-09 for 516.65 (July remainder 168.04 + 3.00 + August bill 340.50 + 5.11), balance 799.43. service_charges: twelve bills 2025-10..2026-09, arrangement installments and rebill, late charges, reconnect fees 2024-12-12 and 2025-11-24, the June meter test fee, the arrears_to_arrangement credit, the 2019 meter_error_refund credit and the 2025-09 returned payment fee. service_payments: card payments, the liheap payment, the county payment, the echeck and mail check, two liheap pledges, the 2025-09 return set. Cross: arrangement (defaulted), deposit (partially_paid, 150.00 held of 300.00, assessed 2025-11-24 reconnect_after_nonpay), light rental (out_of_service since 2026-09-29), prepay (converted 2022). Balance reconciles to the seeded ledger from billing period 2025-10 onward; older rows (2019 credit, 2024-12 reconnect fee, 2025-09 return set) belong to settled periods. Automatic clauses: no notice owed on the September bill before 2026-10-10; no finaling before 2026-10-22; no cash-only; no medical date; the light's outage credit begins only after ten business days (2026-10-13).
[Persona] Plain-spoken farm wife; volunteers the goal, the hard preference (keys her card into the automated line herself) and situation; only when asked: credentials, name, meter location, recent payments without amounts, no medical certificate. Passive: agrees to anything put on the account first, pays exactly the quoted amount and reads back the confirmation, may say once it is high, ends when told reconnected. No ask of her own; no computed answer.
[Reachability] Locate and verify (0412763 + 2705551384); read account, charges, payments, trouble reports, arrangement, deposit, light, prepay; read the two prerequisite sentences, see both states false, explain; book 3.77 and 39.95; compute 983.25 and hand over the disconnected-account payment line; she pays; reconnect with 115.00. All synchronous at frozen_time.
[Standard solution and traps] Writes: late charge (2026-09, 3.77), refund (test id, meter_error_refund, 39.95), member payment 983.25, reconnect 115.00. Traps: quoting the notice less the month's payments (221.65); counting the uncleared echeck and mail check; summing both pledges; adding only a third of the deposit instead of the accelerated remainder; refunding six periods or the share of the charges instead of re-pricing at the block-2 rate; counting reconnections over the rolling twelve months instead of since connection; computing the payment before the late charge and refund exist (979.48 / 1023.20 / 1019.43).
[Verification run, round 2] Evaluator (check_compute internals with gold replayed to each handling time): late 3.77 baseline 8.67 {3.23, 5.74, 5.03, 4.76, 3.93, 4.47}; refund 39.95 baseline 45.25 {69.11, 40.84, 56.21, 31.77, 39.77, 19.95}; payment 983.25 baseline 221.65 {441.65, 763.25, 893.25, 1133.25, 833.25}; fee 115.00 baseline 75.00 {165.00, 90.00, 65.00, 105.00, 100.00, 100.00}; final balance -105.00.
[Solvability vs GT] Step 11 cites the September facility line for due_date_passed and frozen_time; step 13 binds the test id and meter_error_refund for one_credit_per_source; step 15 binds the account for cash_only_channel; step 17 binds the arrangement row for past_due_covered (prior_step:15 is the covering payment) and the deposit row for deposit_on_file.
[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the rule prose, docstrings, persona and finder rows alone: reconnection request -> its rule waits on the member's payment of the reconnection payment -> that rule waits on late lines and refund credits -> both missing -> 3.77 and 39.95 -> 983.25 -> 115.00, the same as gold; the only ordering freedom (L vs C) commutes.
[Known modelling note] The accelerated deposit remainder is collected inside the reconnection payment as the deposit charter's 'counts as past due on the service account for collection' allows; the deposit record itself is the deposit difficulty's to post (no cross-category write here), and no rule of this tree reads the deposit's paid status after the payment.
[Round-2 rework log] G1 (mislabelled multipliers): assisted_household_multiplier and overbilling_interest relabelled parameter; the reconnect fee's multiplier removed and replaced by the reconnection_lookback_window method (value 45.00 -> 115.00), whose tiers since round 3 change the look-back's anchor event rather than its length. G3: refund_base_lines replaced by over_registered_energy_pricing (41.31 -> 39.95). G4/T0-1: deposit tier rewritten to the deposit charter and the deposit seeded at its 50 percent first installment (150.00 held); payment 931.89 -> 983.25. G5: compute-only conjunct removed from pledge_selected. G7: fully-covered-pledge sentence declared in overwrite. G8: user-tool docstrings scoped to disconnected versus idle accounts; the single-write claim corrected above. G11: test-fee reach limited to meter_error_rebill_max_months. G15: deposit surcharge reads the assessment basis. Light outage date moved to 2026-09-29. Downstream propagated to computations, tracing, prerequisite_closure, solvability_contract and this dossier; all per-task gates re-run green.
[Audit observations, round 2] G9: the R->P gate label names the base past_due_covered gate the payment completes; the edge's own condition is the stricter payment row. G10: the partial late-charge refund is now declared against 'A late charge is never partly waived.' (a refund at the overbilled share, posted as a meter_error_refund, not a waiver). G12: the pledge credit lowers what the member pays now and moves no money; the account is credited only when agency funds arrive, as base says. G13: the program-charge override's replaced_by now quotes both the area-light and the arrangement-line sentences. G16: payments_applied keys on the agency of the latest agency payment; a month with payments from two agencies is outside this world and the rule says the same ('those agency payments ... from an agency'). G19: unclaimed event types are out of this difficulty's two trees by design.
[Round-3 rework log] R2-G1 / R2-1 (reconnect fee had no honest method because the look-back tiers only selected 24 / 18 / 12 months): the look-back ladder now selects the starting event of the count - connect date (defaulted arrangement in twelve months), latest returned payment (a return in twelve months), or a rolling standard_lookback_months window - and the default/return month constants are removed from params. The world, the tier taken and every figure are unchanged: 2 reconnect fees counted since connection, fee 115.00, factor baseline 90.00, whole baseline 75.00. Reconnect fee factors now: P 5 / M 1. Task 1 is untouched.
user_scenario:
You are Marcy Albright, fifty-eight, who keeps a small cow-calf and hay operation with your husband off Sulphur Lick Road outside Harlan Springs. The farmhouse, the well pump and the machine shed all run on one Cedar Fork meter, the only meter you have. Cedar Fork shut your power off for nonpayment last Thursday, October 1st; you knew you had fallen behind after the hay baler repairs this summer, and the payment plan you set up in May came apart in August. You have a chest freezer of beef and cattle drinking off that well, so you are calling member services this morning because you want the power turned back on today. You talk plainly, a little tired and embarrassed, and you do not ramble.

You open by saying the power at the farm was shut off last week for not paying, that you want it turned back on today, and that you need to know what you have to pay right now to get it back on. You intend to pay today with your debit card, but you key card numbers into the cooperative's automated phone payment line yourself; you never read a card number to a person. You are not asking for a payment plan, a waiver or anything else, only the amount it takes and the reconnection.

When the representative asks who you are, you give your membership number, 0412763, and the phone number on the account, 2705551384. If they ask your name, it is Marcy Albright. You do not know the account number by heart; it is the farm meter at 6612 Sulphur Lick Road. If they ask about recent payments, you say you mailed them a check last week and paid something online over the weekend, and that the LIHEAP office told you they were putting in a pledge for you, but you do not remember the exact amounts and you would rather they look at what they have. If they ask whether you have a medical certificate on file, you say no.

If the representative tells you something else has to be put on the account or looked after before they can give you the figure, you tell them to go ahead and do whatever the rules call for, because you only want the right number. When they give you the amount to pay and hand you over to the automated payment line, you run it yourself for that account and for exactly the amount they quoted, and you read the confirmation number back to them when it gives you one. If the amount sounds higher than you expected, you say so once and ask them to make sure it is right, then you go along with the figure they confirm. Once the representative tells you the account has been reconnected and the power is coming back on, you thank them and end the call without bringing up anything else.
